bagPolicy.summary: Only small clutches, purses and fanny packs up to about 6" x 6" x 2" are allowed at Sphere. Large bags and backpacks are not.
allowed: Small clutches, purses and fanny packs up to about 6" x 6" x 2"
prohibited: Outside food and beverage, including sealed cans and bottles
bagPolicy.note: All bags get extra screening by visual or x-ray inspection. Sphere has no bag or coat check.

parking.note: Parking information for Sphere is not detailed on the provided page. Visitors are encouraged to check the official website for updates on parking options and pricing.

rideshare.note: Use the rideshare pickup and drop-off area at Manhattan Street and Westchester Drive.

concessions.note: Sphere offers a diverse range of world-class food and beverage options, including signature cocktails and unique items like Hot Honey Chicken Tenders and Over The Rainbow Popcorn. Dining options include various themed restaurants and bars, with some locations offering quick service and self-checkout kiosks.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Guests may access the captioning via a complimentary Assistive Listening Device (ALD) which is available at the Guest Services Offices located on levels 2 and 6. Please contact the Accessibility Services Department here or 725-258-6724 at least 48 hours in advance of your event to allow time for any necessary accommodations.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: All exits are final, so you can't leave and re-enter.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Sphere uses mobile tickets only, shown on your smartphone. Add them to your phone's digital wallet before you arrive; one phone can display more than one ticket.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: For accessible entry, come onto the property from Sands Avenue and enter the venue through the East Entry or West Entry. The Venetian pedestrian bridge, reached from The Venetian Resort, is also an accessible entrance.
